designationHistory.name: Half-Way Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the refuge as the Half-Way Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 8120, reserving 160 acres in Stutsman County, North Dakota.
designationHistory.note: The Federal Register text confirms the order, its May 10, 1939 date, 160 acres in Stutsman County and the name; the order number 8120 is read from the FWS copy and the FWS CCP table (EO 8119 is Florence Lake per the Presidency Project). The Presidency Project has no page for EO 8120. Proclamation 2416 (July 25, 1940) renamed it Half-Way Lake National Wildlife Refuge.
